Innovation starts from the heart. Edwards Lifesciences is a leading global structural heart innovation company, driven by a passion to improve patient lives. With millions of patients served in over 100 countries, each team makes a meaningful contribution by improving patient outcomes and discovering lasting solutions for unmet patient needs. Our Therapy Development Marketing Manager position is a unique career opportunity to help advance the diagnosis and referral of patients with aortic stenosis across Europe. How you’ll make an impact: Shape and drive the European Therapy Development strategy for referrer engagement, including the ongoing evolution of the CATALYST program and related diagnosis and referral pathway initiatives. Own the CATALYST program strategy and roadmap, ensuring that the program supports earlier, higher-quality referrals through targeted, relevant and repeated engagement with referring healthcare professionals. Partner closely with country marketing and commercial field teams to identify referral barriers, understand local referral ecosystems and translate these insights into actionable engagement strategies. Develop and continuously optimize HCP engagement strategies, supporting interaction models such as educational sessions, referral events, structured field engagement activities, peer-to-peer exchanges and digital programs. Lead the development of account activation approaches, enabling local teams to identify priority stakeholders, referral bottlenecks and opportunities for sustainable pathway improvement. Partner with Medical Affairs and Professional Education to develop HCP education programs and engage appropriate faculty supporting referral excellence, scientific exchange and best-practice sharing. Act as a central coordination point across a highly matrixed European organization, ensuring cross-functional alignment. Serve as a key point of contact for assigned European markets, supporting local teams with the planning and execution of CATALYST and referrer engagement initiatives while encouraging consistency and adaptation to local needs. Define and monitor program success measures with the associate marketing manager. Consolidate learnings and best practices across markets, sharing insights and recommending improvements to strengthen the effectiveness and scalability of Therapy Development programs. Manage cross-functional projects, external agencies and program budgets, ensuring high-quality delivery, appropriate governance and alignment with annual strategic priorities. Act as a strategic partner to the Therapy Development leadership team, helping connect priorities across CATALYST, referrer engagement, education, field enablement and market activation to ensure activities are cohesive, mutually reinforcing and aligned with long-term program evolution. What you’ll need (Required): University degree in Life Sciences, Medicine or a related field, with significant experience in Therapy Development, HCP engagement, strategic marketing, commercial excellence or a comparable healthcare/life sciences role. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Additional European languages (e.g., French, German, or Italian) are considered an advantage. What else we look for (Preferred): Ability to define strategy, lead referrer HCP engagement programs, and move complex initiatives from insight to execution across European markets. Strong understanding of patient pathways, referral behaviors and healthcare ecosystem dynamics, ideally in cardiovascular disease, aortic stenosis, TAVI or structural heart disease. Experience developing HCP engagement strategies, educational programs, marketing campaigns or field enablement tools in partnership with commercial field teams. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex clinical, scientific and business information into clear recommendations for senior audiences. Proven ability to influence without authority, align cross-functional stakeholders, and work effectively in a matrixed, international environment. Strong analytical and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize, monitor performance and drive continuous improvement. Familiarity with digital engagement tools, CRM-based campaigns, dashboards or program performance reporting. Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Metapic Arianna Giuffrè Arianna Giuffrè Country Lead Italy @Metapic | Launching, Leading & Scaling Influencer Marketing Operations We are looking for a Creator Growth Manager to join our team in Italy and take ownership of the growth, activation and retention of our creator community. This is a highly people-oriented and entrepreneurial role, combining creator relationship management, community building, data-driven decision making and operational ownership. You will be the key point of contact for creators throughout their journey with Metapic. You will play a key role in shaping how we grow our creator community in Italy, identifying the profiles with the strongest potential, building meaningful relationships and creating scalable ways to turn new sign-ups into active, high-performing creators. Creator-first & interpersonal Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain Metapic’s value proposition clearly and in a simple, creator-friendly way. Confident presenting to groups, whether at creator events, feature launches or community sessions. Comfortable being on camera and creating engaging onboarding content for social media and WhatsApp. Analytical & commercially minded Comfortable working with data and performance metrics such as clicks, conversion rates and order value to prioritize your outreach and activities. Strong pattern-recognition skills and curiosity about emerging trends, formats and opportunities within the creator economy. Able to translate data and creator feedback into actionable insights. Highly organized & entrepreneurial Highly organized and structured, with the ability to manage a growing creator pipeline without letting opportunities fall through the cracks. A self-starter who is comfortable working autonomously and building new processes and playbooks from scratch. Entrepreneurial mindset: you will essentially be building and owning a mini business unit within the Italian market, with a strong sense of ownership over results. Key Requirement Italian speaker – 100% required. Native-level Italian is essential for this role, both written and spoken. The person will communicate daily with Italian creators, host local events, create Italian-language onboarding content and represent Metapic within the Italian creator community. Excellent English communication skills are also required for collaboration with the international Metapic team. Segnala offerta di lavoro Chi siamo HAVAS PLAY è la unit dedicata a sport, entertainment e brand experience del Gruppo HAVAS. Lavoriamo al fianco dei nostri Clienti per costruire connessioni autentiche con le persone, attraverso contenuti, sponsorship e attivazioni capaci di generare impatto emotivo e rilevanza culturale. Il ruolo All’interno del Team Sports di HAVAS PLAY siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Sports Marketing Manager con una forte passione per il mondo dello sport, capacità di coordinamento progettuale e spiccata attitudine relazionale e commerciale. La figura avrà un ruolo chiave nello sviluppo di relazioni con clienti e prospect, nell’individuazione di opportunità di business e nella trasformazione di queste opportunità in progetti e partnership di valore, coordinandone l’implementazione insieme ai team interni. Responsabilità principali Gestire e sviluppare le relazioni con i clienti interni al Gruppo Havas, individuando opportunità di crescita e nuove progettualità; Contribuire alla definizione, elaborazione e presentazione di proposte e progetti di sport sponsorship, comunicazione e brand partnership, coordinando il contributo dei team interni coinvolti; Contribuire all’identificazione e allo sviluppo di nuove opportunità di business attraverso attività di networking, scouting e relazione con prospect e stakeholder del mercato sportivo; Monitorare il mercato sportivo, le principali property e i trend del settore per identificare nuove opportunità di investimento e collaborazione; Assicurare il corretto coordinamento tra clienti, partner e team interni durante tutte le fasi progettuali, monitorando l’avanzamento delle attività e garantendo il rispetto di tempistiche, priorità e budget concordati. Requisiti Laurea in Marketing, Economia, Comunicazione o discipline affini; 3-5 anni di esperienza (inclusi eventuali percorsi di stage) in ambito sport marketing, sponsorship, eventi, marketing o comunicazione; Interesse per le attività di business development e per la costruzione di relazioni commerciali; Esperienza nella gestione di progetti e nel coordinamento di stakeholder interni ed esterni; Ottime capacità organizzative, relazionali e di gestione simultanea di più attività; Approccio proattivo, orientato alla soluzione e ai risultati; Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata; Ottima padronanza del pacchetto Office, in particolare PowerPoint ed Excel; Passione per il mondo dello sport e conoscenza dell’ecosistema delle sponsorship sportive. Cosa offriamo Inserimento in un ambiente dinamico, internazionale e creativo; Opportunità di lavorare su progetti innovativi con brand e partner di riferimento nel panorama sportivo; Percorso di crescita professionale all’interno di una realtà in continua evoluzione. Sede di lavoro: Milano Orario di lavoro: Full-time Tipologia di contratto: Tempo indeterminato Fascia retributiva (retribuzione annua lorda): € 40.000-45.000 Il pacchetto retributivo proposto è determinato in base a criteri oggettivi e trasparenti, e tiene conto dei requisiti richiesti, complessità del ruolo, riferimenti di mercato ed equilibrio interno.
